environment.server_version: Gleam 1.18.1; OTP 29; ERTS 17.0.6; native Erlang shipment, existing caches and export overhead included

limitations: Local fixture measurements do not establish uptime or production capacity.
HTTP latencies include client scheduling and connection overhead; urllib uses fresh requests.
Repository-list results include any pre-existing server data; use isolated fresh data directories.

fixture.description: One populated repository; all remaining repositories are empty. Populated default branch has 20 commits, 100 generated source files plus the base fixture, and a 1 MiB incompressible binary.

memory.method: ps sampled every 50ms plus ps execution time; RSS units KiB; not a kernel peak
memory.sampling_scope: Measured HTTP and Git phases, after fixture setup and warmup
